h: Putin, Trump and Xi meet at APEC reception ahead of three-way talks
p: Vladimir Putin greeted Donald Trump at an APEC welcome reception in Shenzhen hosted by Xi Jinping. The three leaders are expected to hold a rare trilateral meeting.
body: Russian President Vladimir Putin joined US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping at a welcome reception for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday, 18 November 2026.

Footage from the reception showed Putin walking up to Trump and shaking hands as Xi looked on during the welcome banquet and group photo. It was the first in-person meeting between Trump and Putin since their August 2025 summit in Alaska.
The leaders are expected to hold a trilateral meeting, widely seen as the highlight of the gathering. It would be the first time the three have held joint face-to-face talks.
The two-day APEC leaders' meeting, themed around building a prosperous Asia-Pacific community, is focusing on regional economic integration, trade, investment, AI governance and supply chains.
more: It was Trump and Putin's first meeting since August 2025.
A three-way meeting with Xi is planned.
APEC is being held in Shenzhen, China.
